# PixelFix

> Free browser-based photo tools: compress images, restore old photos, remove backgrounds, make passport photos, PDF tools, GIF maker, batch watermark, document scanner and photo animation — all 100% in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, no account, no signup. Compress is free; a one-time $9.99 unlocks every tool forever.

## Tools

- [Compress Images](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/compress-image.html): Shrink JPG/PNG/WebP in batch, resize, convert formats. Free.
- [Restore Photos](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/restore.html): Fix faded, blurry and noisy old photos with auto-fix and manual sliders.
- [Animate Photos](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/): Ken Burns push-in/pan/fade effect turned into an animated GIF.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/passport-photo.html): Generate official passport, visa and ID photos in correct sizes.
- [Remove Background](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/remove-bg.html): Cut people out with feathered edges; replace the background.
- [PDF Tools](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/pdf-tools.html): Images to PDF, merge PDFs, and PDF to JPG in your browser.
- [GIF Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/gif-maker.html): Turn any set of images into an animated, looping GIF.
- [Watermark](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/watermark.html): Add text or logo watermarks to images in batch.
- [Document Scanner](https://aiharryone.github.io/pixelfix/document-scanner.html): Straighten, crop and flatten photos of documents.

## Pricing

- Compress Images: completely free.
- All other tools: one free try each.
- $9.99 one-time (no subscription): unlock all tools forever, watermark-free.
